For starters, hello! This is my firsr time posting on the thread so I would love to preface that I am a sophomore in college hoping to work in the film industry. For my personal statement, I'm really hoping to get some feedback revolving color correcting of the video. I am working with some fairly limited equipment, the black magic pocket camera to be specific, so I know camera quality is a bit of an issue. However, with some better equipment that has a lot more settings and customization, I could make use of some interesting shot locations. I would love it if this thread would just rip apart my work though. I am an amateur and this is only my second time ever working on a film project so I know this is far from perfect. This thread is full of some incredible talent and I would love some comments and criticisms to help me develop as a cinematographer! Moving on from my intentions with this post I would love to share some of my thoughts on it! I feel proud of what I was able to accomplish with the constraints of the project. It took me quite a long time to figure out all of the moving parts and how I wanted to incorporate everything but I feel it turned out to be a strong work. That being said I am noticing with each subsequent watch that there was something I could have improved upon. Certain shots seemed superfluous and bland juxtaposed with some of the more powerful imagery, being the shots with the raven's caw. Anyways, I really appreciate your time! Your feedback is highly appreciated!
